H0216.strongs: illumination or (concrete) luminary (in every sense, including lightning, happiness, etc.)
H0216.kjv: bright, clear, [phrase] day, light (-ning), morning, sun
senses: light of heavenly luminaries (moon, sun, stars)

H0259.strongs: properly, united, i.e. one; or (as an ordinal) first
H0259.kjv: a, alike, alone, altogether, and, any(-thing), apiece, a certain, (dai-) ly, each (one), [phrase] eleven, every, few, first, [phrase] highway, a man, once, one, only, other, some, together,
senses: one...another, the one...the other, one after another, one by one

H0226.root: probably from [[w:H0225]] (in the sense of appearing)
H0226.strongs: a signal (literally or figuratively), as aflag, beacon, monument, omen, prodigy, evidence, etc.

H0215.strongs: to be (causative, make) luminous (literally and metaphorically)
H0215.kjv: [idiom] break of day, glorious, kindle, (be, en-, give, show) light (-en, -ened), set on fire, shine
senses: to be or become light, shine
to give light, shine (of sun, moon, and stars)
to illumine, light up, cause to shine, shine
lighten (of the eyes, his law, etc)

H0251.strongs: a brother (used in the widest sense of literal relationship and metaphorical affinity or resemblance (like father))
H0251.kjv: another, brother(-ly); kindred, like, other. Compare also the proper names beginning with 'Ah-' or 'Ahi-'

H0269.strongs: a sister (used very widely (like brother), literally and figuratively)

H0238.root: a primitive root; probably to expand; but used only as a denominative from [[w:H0241]]
H0238.strongs: to broaden out the ear (with the hand), i.e. (by implication) to listen
H0238.kjv: give (perceive by the) ear, hear(-ken). See [[w:H0239]]
senses: to hear or listen to prayers (of God)

H0227.strongs: at that time or place; also as a conjunction, therefore
H0227.kjv: beginning, for, from, hitherto, now, of old, once, since, then, at which time, yet

H0211.root: or (shortened) אֹפִיר; and אוֹפִר; of uncertain derivation
H0211.strongs: Ophir, the name of a son of Joktan, and of a gold region in the East
senses: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.10.29; son of: Joktan (H3355); brother of: Almodad (H0486), Sheleph (H8026), Hazarmaveth (H2700), Jerah (H3392), Hadoram (H1913A), Uzal (H0187), Diklah (H1853), Obal (H5745), Abimael (H0039), Sheba (H7614H), Havilah (H2341I) and Jobab (H3103) § Ophir = "reducing to ashes"
a land or city in southern Arabia in Solomon's trade route where gold evidently was traded for goods

H0218.strongs: Ur, a place in Chaldaea; also an Israelite
senses: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.11.35; father of: Eliphal (H0465) § Ur = "flame" father of one of David's heroes

H0272.strongs: something seized, i.e. a possession (especially of land)

H0213.strongs: to press; (by implication) to be close, hurry, withdraw
senses: to press, be pressed, make haste, urge, be narrow

H0241.strongs: broadness. i.e. (concrete) the ear (from its form in man)
H0241.kjv: [phrase] advertise, audience, [phrase] displease, ear, hearing, [phrase] show
senses: ear, as part of the body
(subjective) to uncover the ear to reveal; the receiver of divine revelation

H0270.strongs: to seize (often with the accessory idea of holding in possession)
H0270.kjv: [phrase] be affrighted, bar, (catch, lay, take) hold (back), come upon, fasten, handle, portion, (get, have or take) possess(-ion)
senses: grasp, take hold, seize, take possession
(Niphal) to be caught, grasped, be settled
A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, only mentioned at Gen.26.26 § Ahuzzath = "possession" friend of Abimelech

H0225.strongs: properly, to come, i.e. (implied) to assent

senses: A man of the Edomites living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.36.11; son of: Eliphaz (H0464); brother of: Teman (H8487), Zepho (H6825), Gatam (H1609), Kenaz (H7073), Amalek (H6002H) and Korah (H7141H) § Omar = "speaker" or "eloquent" grandson of Esau

H0208.strongs: Onam, the name of an Edomite and of an Israelite
senses: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.36.23; son of: Shobal (H7732); brother of: Alvan (H5935), Manahath (H4506B), Ebal (H5858B) and Shepho (H8195) § Onam = "vigorous"
a Horite chief, grandson of Seir
son Jerahmeel, a chief of Judah

A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.38.4; son of: Judah (H3063) and Bath-shua (H1323I); brother of: Er (H6147) and Shelah (H7956); half-brother of: Perez (H6557) and Zerah (H2226I) § Onan = "strong" second son of Judah, slain by God for not fulfilling the levitical requirement to beget a child with the wife of a dead, childless brother

H0260.strongs: a bulrush or any marshy grass (particularly that along the Nile)

senses: § On = "strength or vigour" city in lower Egypt, bordering land of Goshen, centre of sun-worship, residence of Potipherah (priest of On and father-in-law of Joseph)

A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.46.21; son of: Benjamin (H1144); brother of: Bela (H1106A), Becher (H1071), Ashbel (H0788), Gera (H1617), Naaman (H5283), Rosh (H7220), Muppim (H4649), Huppim (H2650H), Ard (H0714), Ahiram (H0297) and Jediael (H3043); also called Aharah at 1Ch.8.1; Also named: ach.rach (אַחְרַח "Aharah" H0315) § Ehi = "my brother" son of Benjamin

H0202.root: probably from the same as [[w:H0205]] (in the sense of effort, but successful)

H0268.strongs: the hinder part; hence (adverb) behind, backward; also (as facing north) the West
H0268.kjv: after(-ward), back (part, -side, -ward), hereafter, (be-) hind(-er part), time to come, without

H0249.root: from [[w:H2224]] (in the sense of springing up)
H0249.strongs: a spontaneous growth, i.e. native (tree or persons)
H0249.kjv: bay tree, (home-) born (in the land), of the (one's own) country (nation)
senses: a native (one rising from the soil)
hyssop, a plant used for medicinal and religious purposes

H0212.root: or (shortened) אֹפָן; from an unused root meaning to revolve
senses: wheels of the ten bases beneath the lavers in Solomon's temple

H0224.strongs: Urim, the oracular brilliancy of the figures in the high-priest's breastplate
senses: Urim = "lights" stones kept in a pouch on the high-priest's breastplate, used in determining God's decision in certain questions and issues Also named: dēlos (δῆλος "Urim" G1212)

H0221.strongs: Uri, the name of three Israelites
senses: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Exo.31.2; son of: Hur (H2354); brother of: Shobal (H7732H), Salma (H8007H), Hareph (H2780), Jezreel (H3157J), Ishma (H3457), Idbash (H3031), Hazzelelponi (H6753), Penuel (H6439H) and Ezer (H5829); father of: Bezalel (H1212) § Uri = "fiery"
a prince of Judah, a son of Hur who was used by God to prepare the tabernacle
an officer (or the father of an officer) of Solomon in Gilead
a porter or gatekeeper in time of Ezra who took a foreign woman as wife

A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Exo.31.6; father of: Oholiab (H0171) § Ahisamach = "my brother is support (has supported)" a Danite, father of Aholiab, a workman on the tabernacle
memorial-offering, the portion of the meal (food) offering which is burned

H0295.strongs: Achiezer, the name of two Israelites
senses: A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.1.12; son of: Ammishaddai (H5996) § Ahiezer = "my brother is help"
a Danite chief who assisted Moses
a Danite chief, one of David's heroes
A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.1.15; son of: Enan (H5881) § Ahira = "my brother is evil" a chief of Naphtali

H0289.root: or אֲחִימָן; from [[w:H0251]] and [[w:H4480]]; brother of a portion (i.e. gift)
H0289.strongs: Achiman, the name of an Anakite and of an Israelite
senses: A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.13.22; son of: Anak (H6061); brother of: Sheshai (H8344) and Talmai (H8526) § Ahiman = "my brother is a gift"
a Levite servant in the temple
A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at Num.16.1; son of: Peleth (H6431) § On = "wealth" or "vigour" a chief of the tribe of Reuben

H0205.root: from an unused root perhaps meaning properly, to pant (hence, to exert oneself, usually in vain; to come to naught)
H0205.strongs: strictly nothingness; also trouble. vanity, wickedness; specifically an idol
H0205.kjv: affliction, evil, false, idol, iniquity, mischief, mourners(-ing), naught, sorrow, unjust, unrighteous, vain, vanity, wicked(-ness). Compare [[w:H0369]]

H0244.strongs: Ozni, an Israelite; also an Oznite (collectively), his descendant
senses: A man of the tribe of Gad living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.46.16; son of: Gad (H1410); brother of: Ziphion (H6837), Haggi (H2291), Shuni (H7764), Eri (H6179), Arod (H0720) and Areli (H0692); also called Ozni at Num.26.16; Another name of ets.bon (אֶצְבּוֹן "Ezbon" H0675G) § Ozni = "my ear (hearing)" son of Gad

H0297.root: from [[w:H0251]] and [[w:H7311]]; brother of height (i.e. high)
senses: A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at Num.26.38; son of: Benjamin (H1144); brother of: Bela (H1106A), Becher (H1071), Ashbel (H0788), Gera (H1617), Naaman (H5283), Ehi (H0278), Rosh (H7220), Muppim (H4649), Huppim (H2650H), Ard (H0714) and Jediael (H3043) Also named: a.chi.ra.mi (אֲחִירָמִי "Ahiramite" H0298) § Ahiram = "my brother is exalted" or "brother or (the) lofty" a Benjamite, son of Benjamin

H0298.strongs: an Achiramite or descendant (collectively) of Achiram
senses: Someone descended from Ahiram, a man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at Num.26.38; son of: Benjamin (H1144); brother of: Bela (H1106A), Becher (H1071), Ashbel (H0788), Gera (H1617), Naaman (H5283), Ehi (H0278), Rosh (H7220), Muppim (H4649), Huppim (H2650H), Ard (H0714) and Jediael (H3043) Group of a.chi.ram (אֲחִירָם "Ahiram" H0297) § Ahiramite = "brother of mother" one of the clan of Ahiram

H0282.root: from [[w:H0251]] and [[w:H1935]]; brother (i.e. possessor) of renown
senses: A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at Num.34.27; son of: Shelomi (H8015) § Ahihud = "brother of majesty" a prince of Asher

H0240.strongs: a spade or paddle (as having a broad end)

senses: store, supplies of food or drink
magazine of weapons (fig. of God's armoury)
storehouses (of God for rain, snow, hail, wind, sea)

H0235.strongs: to go away, hence, to disappear
H0235.kjv: fail, gad about, go to and fro (but in Ezekiel 27:19 the word is rendered by many 'from Uzal,' by others 'yarn'), be gone (spent)
senses: to go, to go away, to go about
to be used up, be exhausted, be gone, evaporated

H0243.root: from [[w:H0238]] and [[w:H8396]]; flats (i.e. tops) of Tabor (i.e. situated on it)
senses: § Aznoth Tabor = "peaks of Tabor" a pair of hills on Naphtali's border
(Qal) to gird, gird on (metaphorical of strength)

H0281.root: or (prolonged) אֲחִיָּהוּ; from [[w:H0251]] and [[w:H3050]]; brother (i.e. worshipper) of Jah
H0281.strongs: Achijah, the name of nine Israelites
senses: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ki.4.3; son of: Seraiah (H8304); brother of: Elihoreph (H0456) § Ahiah or Ahijah = "brother of Jehovah (Yahu)"
a prophet who predicted the revolt of the Northern tribes
father of Baasha, who usurped the Northern throne
grandson of Hezron (or mother of 1-4 above)

H0285.strongs: Achitub, the name of several priests
senses: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.14.3; son of: Phinehas (H6372H); brother of: Ichabod (H0350); father of: Ahimelech (H0288) § Ahitub = "my brother is good (goodness)"
the father of Zadok the priest

H0293.strongs: Achinoam, the name of two Israelitesses
senses: A woman living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Sa.14.50; daughter of: Ahimaaz (H0290); married to Saul (H7586G); mother of: Jonathan (H3083H), Abinadab (H0041H), Malchi-shua (H4444), Merab (H4764) and Michal (H4324) § Ahinoam = "my brother is delight"
wife of Saul, daughter of Ahimaaz
wife of David, mother of Amnon, a Jezreelitess

H0290.root: from [[w:H0251]] and the equivalent of [[w:H4619]]; brother of anger
H0290.strongs: Achimaats, the name of three Israelites
senses: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Sa.14.50; father of: Ahinoam (H0293) § Ahimaaz = "my brother is anger (wrath)"
Zadok's son who aided David during Absalom's rebellion

H0237.strongs: Ezel, a memorial stone in Palestine
senses: § Ezel = "departure" a memorial stone between Ramah and Nob; scene of final farewell between David and Jonathan

H0288.strongs: Achimelek, the name of an Israelite and of a Hittite
senses: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.14.3; son of: Ahitub (H0285); father of: Abiathar (H0054); also called Ahijah (KJV: Ahiah) at 1Sa.14.3,18; Also named: a.chiy.yah (אֲחִיָּ֫הוּ "Ahijah" H0281O) § Ahimelech = "my brother is king" or "brother of Melek"
a priest murdered by Doeg at Saul's command, for supposedly assisting David

H0283.strongs: Achio, the name of three Israelites
senses: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.6.3; son of: Abinadab (H0041); brother of: Eleazar (H0499H) and Uzzah (H5798A) § Ahio = "brotherly" or "fraternal"
son of Abinadab who sheltered the ark

H0286.root: from [[w:H0251]] and [[w:H3205]]; brother of one born
senses: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.8.16; father of: Jehoshaphat (H3092), Baana (H1195) § Ahilud = "child's brother"
father of Baana, an officer of Solomon

H0223.root: or (prolonged) אוּרִיָּהוּ; from [[w:H0217]] and [[w:H3050]]; flame of Jah
H0223.strongs: Urijah, the name of one Hittite and five Israelites
senses: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.11.3; married to Bathsheba (H1339) Also named: Ourias (Οὐρίας "Uriah" G3774) § Uriah or Urijah = "Jehovah (Yahweh) is my light (flame)"
a priest who built king Ahaz' heathen altar
a priest who rebuilt Jerusalem's wall

H0266.strongs: an Achochite or descendant of Achoach
senses: Someone descended from Ahoah, a man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at 2Sa.23.9; son of: Bela (H1106A); brother of: Ard (H0714H), Naaman (H5283H), Ezbon (H0675H), Uzzi (H5813I), Uzziel (H5816I), Jerimoth (H3406), Iri (H5901), Addar (H0146H), Gera (H1617I), Abihud (H0031) and Abishua (H0050H); also called Ahoah at 1Ch.8.4; Group of a.cho.ach (אֲחוֹחַ "Ahoah" H0265) § Ahohite = "brother of rest" one of the clan of Ahoah

H0279.root: from [[w:H0251]] and [[w:H0517]]; brother of the mother (i.e. uncle)
senses: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.23.33; son of: Sharar (H8325) § Ahiam = "mother's brother" one of David's warriors (heroes)
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ki.4.14; son of: Iddo (H5714) § Ahinadab = "my brother is liberal, or, noble" a supply officer of Solomon

H0250.strongs: an Ezrachite or descendant of Zerach
senses: Someone descended from Ezrah(?), first mentioned at 1Ki.4.31 § Ezraite = "a native (as arising out of the soil)" Ezrahite, of the family of Zerach

H0256.root: once (by contraction) אֶחָב (Jeremiah 29:22); from [[w:H0251]] and [[w:H0001]]; brother (i.e. friend) of (his) father
H0256.strongs: Achab, the name of a king of Israel and of a prophet at Babylon
senses: A king of the Kingdom of Israel, living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ki.16.28; son of: Omri (H6018); married to Jezebel (H0348); father of: Joash (H3101H), Ahaziah (H0274), Joram (H3141H), Athaliah (H6271) § Ahab = "father's brother"
king of Israel, son of Omri, husband of Jezebel
false prophet executed by Nebuchadrezzar, time of Jeremiah

H0274.root: or (prolonged) אֲחַזְיָהוּ; from [[w:H0270]] and [[w:H3050]]; Jah has seized
H0274.strongs: Achazjah, the name of a Jewish and an Israelite king
senses: A king of the Kingdom of Israel, living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ki.22.40; son of: Ahab (H0256) and Jezebel (H0348); brother of: Joash (H3101H), Joram (H3141H) and Athaliah (H6271) § Ahaziah = "Jehovah (Yahu) holds (possesses)"
ruler of Israel, son of Ahab
ruler of Judah, son of Jehoram (Joram)

H0232.strongs: something girt; a belt, also a band
senses: waist-cloth, the innermost piece of clothing

H0219.strongs: luminousness, i.e. (figuratively) prosperity; also a plant (as being bright)

H0271.strongs: Achaz, the name of a Jewish king and of an Israelite
senses: A king of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.15.38; son of: Jotham (H3147H); married to Abi (H0021); father of: Hezekiah (H2396) and Maaseiah (H4641J) Also named: Achaz (Ἀχάζ "Ahaz" G0881) § Ahaz = "he has grasped"
king of Judah, son Jotham, father of Hezekiah
a Benjamite, son of Micah, and great grandson of Jonathan

H0296.root: from [[w:H0251]] and [[w:H6965]]; brother of rising (i.e. high)
senses: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.22.12; son of: Shaphan (H8227B); brother of: Elasah (H0501J) and Gemariah (H1587H); father of: Gedaliah (H1436B) § Ahikam = "my brother has risen (arisen)"
son of Shaphan, an officer in Josiah's reign

H0257.root: from [[w:H0251]] and [[w:H0995]]; brother (i.e. possessor) of understanding
senses: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.2.29; son of: Abishur (H0051) and Abihail (H0032H); brother of: Molid (H4140) § Ahban = "brother of an understanding (intelligent) one" son of Abishur of Judah

H0267.root: perhaps from [[w:H0251]] and [[w:H4325]]; brother (i.e. neighbour) of water
senses: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.2; son of: Jahath (H3189); brother of: Lahad (H3855) § Ahumai = "a water reed: brother of waters" grandson of Shobal, descendant of Judah

A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.6; son of: Ashhur (H0806) and Naarah (H5292B); brother of: Hepher (H2660), Temeni (H8488) and Haahashtari (H0326); half-brother of: Zereth (H6889), Izhar (H3328), Ethnan (H0869) and Koz (H6976) § Ahuzam = "possessor" a descendant of Judah through Caleb

H0277.strongs: Achi, the name of two Israelites
senses: A man of the tribe of Gad living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.5.15; son of: Abdiel (H5661) § Ahi = "my brother"
a head of the families of Gad

H0222.strongs: Uriel, the name of two Israelites
senses: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.6.24; son of: Tahath (H8480H); father of: Uzziah (H5818H); also called Zephaniah at 1Ch.6.36; Also named: tse.phan.yah (צְפַנְיָהוּ "Zephaniah" H6846J) § Uriel = "God (El) is my light"
chief of the Levitical line of Kohath in David's time

A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.6.25; son of: Amasai (H6022); father of: Elkanah (H0511J); also called Mahath at 1Ch.6.35; Also named: ma.chat (מַ֫חַת "Mahath" H4287I) § Ahimoth = "brother of death" or "my brother is death" a son of Elkanah, a Levite

A man of the tribe of Manasseh living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at 1Ch.7.19; son of: Shemida (H8061); brother of: Shechem (H7928H), Likhi (H3949) and Aniam (H0593) § Ahian = "brotherly" or "fraternal" son of Shemida of Manasseh

H0242.root: from [[w:H0238]] and [[w:H7609]]; plot of Sheerah (i.e. settled by him)
senses: § Uzzen Sherah = "portion of Sherah" city built by Sherah, Ephraim's daughter

A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at 2Sa.23.9; son of: Bela (H1106A); brother of: Ard (H0714H), Naaman (H5283H), Ezbon (H0675H), Uzzi (H5813I), Uzziel (H5816I), Jerimoth (H3406), Iri (H5901), Addar (H0146H), Gera (H1617I), Abihud (H0031) and Abishua (H0050H); also called Ahoah at 1Ch.8.4; Also named: a.cho.chi (אֲחוֹחִי "Ahohite" H0266) § Ahoah = "brother of rest" a grandson of Benjamin

H0261.strongs: Echud, the name of three Israelites
senses: A Judge of the tribe of Benjamin living before Israel's Monarchy, first mentioned at Jdg.3.15; son of: Gera (H1617); father of: Naaman (H5283J), Ahijah (H0281K), Gera (H1617J), Uzza (H5798H) and Ahihud (H0284) Another spelling of e.hud (אֵהוּד "Ehud" H0164) § Ehud = "united" great grandson of Benjamin

H0284.root: from [[w:H0251]] and [[w:H2330]]; brother of a riddle (i.e. mysterious)
senses: A man of the tribe of Benjamin living before Israel's Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.8.7; son of: Ehud (H0164); brother of: Naaman (H5283J), Ahijah (H0281K), Gera (H1617J) and Uzza (H5798H) § Ahihud = "brother of mystery" a Benjamite, son of Ehud
a valley (of craftsman) Also named: ke.phi.rim (כְּפִירִים "Hakkephirim" H3715B)
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.11.37; father of: Naarai (H5293) § Ezbai = "my humblings" father of one of David's mighty men
manger, stall, crib Another spelling of ur.vah (אֻרְיָה "stall" H0723)

H0252.strongs: {a brother (used in the widest sense of literal relationship and metaphorical affinity or resemblance)}

senses: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Neh.10.9; father of: Jeshua (H3442J) § Azaniah = "Jehovah (Yahweh) hears" the father of Jeshua, a Levite

A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at 1Ch.9.12; son of: Meshillemith (H4921); father of: Jahzerah (H3170); also called Ahzai (KJV: Ahasai) at Neh.11.13; Another name of me.shul.lam (מְשֻׁלָּם "Meshullam" H4918M) § Ahasai = "my holder, protector" a post-exilic priest, in Jerusalem

H0239.root: a primitive root (rather identical with [[w:H0238]] through the idea of scales as if two ears)

H0255.strongs: a howler or lonesome wild animal

H0217.strongs: flame; hence (in the plural) the East (as being the region of light)

senses: § Uphaz = "desire of fine gold" a place famous for its gold
(Hithpael) to go one way or another, to be sharp
(P'al) to be gone Aramaic of a.zal (אָזַל "be gone" H0235)
